questions.question: Deti z celého Slovenska aj zo zahraničia píšu Ježiškovi. Slovenská pošta im posiela odpovede z malej obce pri Žiline, ktorá je známa aj obrovským dreveným betlehemom. Ako sa tá obec volá?
questions.explanation: Ježiškova pošta tam funguje od konca 90. rokov a každý rok dostane desaťtisíce listov. Slovenský betlehem v miestnom Dome Božieho milosrdenstva patrí k najväčším pohyblivým betlehemom v Európe.

questions.question: Na tradičnom adventnom venci sú tri sviečky fialové a jedna ružová. Na ktorú adventnú nedeľu sa zapaľuje ružová?
questions.explanation: Tretia nedeľa sa volá Gaudete, po latinsky „radujte sa“. Fialovú kajúcnu farbu vtedy na chvíľu zjasní ružová, pretože Vianoce sú už blízko.

questions.question: Prvý adventný veniec mal namiesto štyroch sviečok vyše dvadsať, aby deti v detskom domove vedeli, koľko dní ešte zostáva do Vianoc. Z akého obyčajného predmetu ho vyrobili?
questions.explanation: V Hamburgu ho v roku 1839 vymyslel Johann Hinrich Wichern. Na koleso dal malé červené sviečky na všedné dni a veľké biele na nedele. Z tých štyroch veľkých je dnešný veniec.

How many did you get right?

#christmas #advent #trivia #quiz #didyouknow

questions.question: In Japan, where few people are Christian, a 1970s advertising campaign made Christmas dinner from one American fast-food chain a national custom. Families book their meals well in advance. Which chain?
questions.explanation: It all started with a 1970s advertising slogan, 'Kentucky for Christmas!', and fried chicken has been Japan's festive meal ever since.

questions.question: The very first Advent wreath was made by a Hamburg pastor for children who kept asking how long it was until Christmas. He built it from an old piece of farm equipment. Which one?
questions.explanation: It held a candle for every day of Advent, small ones for weekdays and big ones for Sundays. Later the wreath was shrunk to just the four Sunday candles we know today.

questions.question: In 1965, two astronauts told Mission Control they'd spotted something like Santa in orbit. Then they pulled out a smuggled harmonica and bells and played the first song ever played on instruments in space. Which song?
questions.explanation: The Gemini 6 crew snuck the harmonica and bells aboard, and both instruments are now kept at the Smithsonian.
